instructions: Vantage is a multi-tenant SaaS on Cloudflare Workers with Neon Postgres: every workspace's data must stay isolated. Prioritise correctness and tenant isolation over style. Flag any query or mutation without a workspace predicate, any unauthenticated mutation, any user-supplied URL fetched without lib/http/public-fetch, and any secret or customer data reaching source, tests, fixtures or logs. Error messages returned to customers stay generic; internal detail belongs in logs.

rules.rule: Every query and mutation must be scoped by workspace id. A missing workspace predicate is a P0.
Server actions and API routes must call authorizeWorkspace and refuse on failure before any database write or upstream fetch.
User-supplied URLs must go through fetchPublicText from lib/http/public-fetch. Raw fetch() on user input is a security issue.
Never introduce credentials, tokens or live customer data into source, tests, fixtures or logs.
Fixture sample data must never be persisted or shown as real leads in production unless ALLOW_FIXTURES is explicitly set.
Schema changes must be additive (expand/contract). Dropping a column or table in the same release as the code that stops using it is a bug, because Worker rollbacks run against the current schema.
Runtime code must stay Workers-compatible: fetch-only database access, no Node-only APIs beyond what nodejs_compat provides, and no reliance on long-lived connections or in-process timers.
